text: Dear Dana, I'm so sorry. Your daughter's coat arrived after her birthday and in the wrong size, and then you were cut off after 40 minutes on hold. That is not the service you should get from us, and I understand why you're upset. I'd like to put it right in whichever way suits you. I can send the age 10 coat today by express delivery, so it will arrive within 1-2 days, or I can give you a full refund, which will reach your card in 3-5 working days. Either way I've added a $10 voucher to your account as an apology. Just reply to this email with your choice and I'll confirm it straight away. Kind regards, Sam

Hi Dana, thank you for telling us, and I apologise: we let you down three times over. The coat was late, missed your daughter's birthday, was the wrong size, and our phone line failed you too. I completely understand your frustration. Here is what I can do. If you'd still like the coat, I will send the correct age 10 size by express delivery today and it will arrive in 1-2 days, with a returns label for the age 6 one. If you'd rather not, I will process a full refund now and you will see it within 3-5 working days. I have also added a $10 voucher. Reply with your preference and I'll confirm by tomorrow at the latest. Best wishes, Priya

Dear Ms Okafor, I am really sorry that order #48213 arrived late and in the wrong size, especially for a birthday present, and that you were then cut off on the phone. I understand how disappointing that must have been. You asked for your money back, so I have started a full refund today; it will be back on your card within 3-5 working days and you will receive an email confirming it. You do not need to return the age 6 coat. I've also added a $10 voucher in case you give us another chance. If you would prefer an exchange instead, just reply and I'll send the age 10 by express delivery. Warm regards, Tom

Hello Dana, I'm sorry. Missing your daughter's birthday with the wrong size coat, and then 40 minutes on hold, is a really poor experience and it's our mistake. You can choose: a full refund (3-5 working days) or the age 10 coat sent express so it will arrive in 1-2 days. I've already added a $10 voucher to your account to say sorry. Please reply with which you'd prefer and I will confirm today. I'll also send you a prepaid label for the coat you received. Thanks for your patience, Leah

Dear Dana, Thank you for writing to us, and I am truly sorry. The coat came four days late, after your daughter's birthday, and in age 6 instead of age 10. On top of that you waited 40 minutes and were cut off. I understand why you feel let down. I have arranged a full refund to your original payment method today, which will arrive within 3-5 working days, plus a $10 voucher as an apology. If you would still like the coat for your daughter, reply and I will send the age 10 by express so it will arrive in 1-2 days, at no cost. Kind regards, Ahmed

Dear Dana, I'm very sorry your daughter's coat arrived late and in the wrong size, and that you had a long wait on the phone. I can offer you a full refund or an exchange for the correct size, and I've added a $10 voucher to your account. Please let me know which option you would like. Kind regards, Customer Care

Hi Dana, Apologies for the late delivery and the wrong size coat, I understand this was for a birthday and that makes it worse. We can send you the age 10 by express delivery or refund you in full, whichever you prefer. Let me know and I will sort it out for you. Thanks, Jo

Dear Dana, I am sorry about your order. The coat was late and was the wrong size, which is our mistake. I have processed a full refund to your card. I hope you will consider shopping with us again in the future and I'm sorry for the trouble this has caused you and your daughter. Regards, Mark

Hello Dana. I am sorry that the coat was late and the wrong size, and that you were cut off on the phone, that is frustrating. I will refund you in full and add a $10 voucher. The refund will be with you in 3-5 working days. Kind regards, Ana

Dear Dana, sorry to hear the coat was the wrong size and late for your daughter's birthday. That's really not good enough. I can exchange it for the age 10 size and send it express, or give you a refund. I've also put a voucher on your account. Thanks for letting us know, Ben

Dear Customer, We are sorry for any inconvenience caused by your recent order. We aim to provide a high level of service. Please return the item and a refund will be processed in line with our returns policy. Kind regards, Customer Care Team

Hi Dana, thanks for your email. I can see your order was delayed. Deliveries have been very busy at this time of year. I can offer you an exchange for the right size if you return the coat. Let me know if you need anything else. Regards, Kim

Dear Dana, I understand you are upset about the coat and the phone call. I am sorry about that. Please contact us again so that we can look into what options are available for you. We value your custom and hope to see you again. Kind regards, Paul

Hello, sorry about your coat being the wrong size. We will refund you. Hope this helps and sorry again for the trouble you had with the order and the delivery being late this time. Thanks, Customer Service

Dear Dana, Thank you for contacting us. I have looked into your order number 48213. Our records show it was dispatched on time but the courier was delayed. I will arrange an exchange for the correct size. Regards, Chris

Dear Dana, Our records show the coat was dispatched on time, so the delay was the courier's fault, not ours. You may also want to double check the size on your order as these mistakes do happen. You can return it through our website. Regards, Customer Services

Hi, please calm down. We get a lot of orders and sometimes things go wrong. If you want a refund you will have to fill in the online returns form and wait for the item to be checked. There is nothing we can do about the phone queues. Thanks

Dear customer, thank you for your email. Your feedback has been passed to the relevant team. We hope to resolve your issue in due course. Please do not reply to this email as this inbox is not monitored for incoming messages. Regards

Dana, you should have checked the size before ordering, the website clearly shows age 6 and age 10 as different options. Policy is policy so we can only take it back if it is unworn. Delivery times are estimates and are not guaranteed.
